description: Header file defining interfaces, data structures, enums, and function prototypes for Open Content Decryption Module (OpenCDM) system and session management, including DRM support, key handling, decryption, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system
methods.description: Creates an OpenCDM system instance for a specified key system.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system_extended
methods.description: Creates an OpenCDM system with extended options, returning success or error code.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_system
methods.description: Destroys an OpenCDM system instance.

methods.name: opencdm_is_type_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific DRM key system and MIME type are supported.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves system-specific metadata for a DRM system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_version
methods.description: Returns version string of the DRM system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_drm_time
methods.description: Gets the current time according to the DRM system.

methods.name: opencdm_get_session
methods.description: Retrieves a session instance associated with a key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_get_system_session
methods.description: Retrieves a session within a system instance based on key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_system_supports_server_certificate
methods.description: Checks if the system supports a server certificate.

methods.name: opencdm_system_set_server_certificate
methods.description: Sets a system-wide server certificate.

methods.name: opencdm_get_metric_system_data
methods.description: Retrieves metric data for the DRM system.

methods.name: opencdm_construct_session
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session for decryption with initialization data and callbacks.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_session
methods.description: Destroys a DRM session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_load
methods.description: Loads session data into the CDM context.

methods.name: opencdm_session_update
methods.description: Processes a key message response for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_remove
methods.description: Removes all keys/licenses for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_resetoutputprotection
methods.description: Resets output protection status after playback stops.

methods.name: opencdm_session_set_parameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter key/value pair in the session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_id
methods.description: Returns the session ID string.

methods.name: opencdm_session_has_key_id
methods.description: Checks if a session has a specific key ID.

methods.name: opencdm_session_status
methods.description: Returns the status of a key in a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_error
methods.description: Returns error code for a key in a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_system_error
methods.description: Returns system error code for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_buffer_id
methods.description: Retrieves buffer ID for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_close
methods.description: Closes a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of encrypted data in a session.

methods.name: opencdm_get_metric_session_data
methods.description: Retrieves metric data for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_decrypt_v2
methods.description: Performs decryption with sample info and stream properties.

methods.name: opencdm_dispose
methods.description: Closes cached connections and cleans up.
